# H.E.A.R.S. Audiology

> A full-service audiology practice in Smithtown, NY specializing in hearing aids, diagnostic evaluations, and personalized hearing care for patients of all ages.

H.E.A.R.S. Audiology is a patient-focused audiology clinic led by Kathleen Page and her team, offering comprehensive hearing services including diagnostic testing, hearing aid fitting and repair, pediatric audiology, auditory processing disorder evaluations, and innovative tinnitus treatment options. The practice emphasizes accessibility through telehealth, curbside, and mobile services.

## Key Topics

- Hearing aids
- Auditory processing disorders
- Diagnostic audiological evaluation
- Hearing aid fitting
- Tinnitus treatment
- Levo System
- Bluetooth hearing aids
- Pediatric audiology
- Smithtown, NY
- Kathleen Page
- Telehealth services
- Hearing loss treatment
- Mobile audiology services
- Hearing screening

## Core Services & Expertise

- [Audiology Services](https://www.hearsny.com/services): H.E.A.R.S. audiology services including hearing testing, aid fitting, and diagnostics
- [Diagnostic Audiological Evaluation](https://www.hearsny.com/services/diagnostic-audiologic-evaluation): Diagnostic testing including pure-tone, bone conduction, and speech reception threshold tests
- [Hearing Aid Evaluation](https://www.hearsny.com/services/hearing-aid-evaluation): Hearing aid evaluation and selection services at H.E.A.R.S. Audiology in Smithtown
- [Hearing Aid Dispensing and Fitting](https://www.hearsny.com/services/hearing-aid-fitting): Hearing aid fitting, programming, and patient education services in Smithtown
- [Auditory Processing Evaluations](https://www.hearsny.com/services/auditory-processing-disorders): APD evaluation services for assessing auditory processing disorders in children

## Hearing Aids & Technology

- [Hearing Aids & Accessories](https://www.hearsny.com/hearing-aids): Hearing aids and accessories from various manufacturers in multiple styles
- [Bluetooth Hearing Aids](https://www.hearsny.com/hearing-aids/bluetooth): Bluetooth hearing aids with wireless connectivity in BTE, ITE, and ITC styles
- [Levo System](https://www.hearsny.com/hearing-aids/levo-informational-page): FDA-cleared Levo System for tinnitus treatment using sound therapy
- [CaptionCall](https://www.hearsny.com/hearing-aids/captioncall): CaptionCall captioned telephone and mobile app for hearing loss accessibility

## Specialized Services

- [Tinnitus Treatment Options](https://www.hearsny.com/services/tinnitus-informational-page): Tinnitus treatment options including Levo System therapy at H.E.A.R.S. Smithtown
- [Hearing Aid Repair and Maintenance](https://www.hearsny.com/services/hearing-aid-repair): Hearing aid repair, maintenance, troubleshooting, and warranty service information
- [Telehealth, Curbside, and Drop-box Services](https://www.hearsny.com/services/telehealth): Remote consultation, curbside, and drop-box hearing aid services via telehealth
- [Additional Services](https://www.hearsny.com/services/hearing-aid-programs-services): Mobile services, hearing screening, pediatric audiology, and contractual on-site services
